title: The Silent Void of Space
hook: You scream in space, but does anyone hear?
script: You scream in space, but does anyone hear? What if you yelled at the top of your lungs in the void? Sound needs a medium to travel, and space is a near-perfect vacuum. This means that no sound can exist there. But that's not even the strange part. A star can explode as a supernova with the energy of billions of Suns and make absolutely no sound at all. It's like watching a massive bomb go off in complete silence. If you were to compare the energy released by a supernova to something on Earth, it would be like detonating billions of hydrogen bombs simultaneously, yet the result is an eerie, deafening silence. Would you rather experience the silence of space or the roar of a supernova on Earth?
